q1_issues.issue: "few" is a proportion word the instruction set routes to strength, and it explicitly bars minting a witness for proportion words, so the group + CardinalityPhrase storage is wrong (the vague-count lexicon lists "a few", not bare "few").
The exceptive "aside from being a professor" is compressed into a coined binary head over a group entity and a bare kind, and its copular predication "being a professor" is never parsed at all.
The evaluative adverb "unfortunately" is dropped with no trace.

q2_gaps: exceptive phrase "aside from X" excluding a member from a quantified set — the instruction set mentions "aside from" only as a defeasible-generic exception cue, which needs a generic plus a sub-kind that reverses the property
speaker-oriented / evaluative sentential adverb ("unfortunately") — only Manner adverbs attached to an event are covered
a proportion word in a bare existential ("there are few Ns at Y") — the quantity-to-strength rule needs a subject-predicate pair (an Inheritance or a rule), and an existential clause supplies none
notes: career_possibility is fused and given its head-noun genus with no genus for the noun modifier, which is correct. LocatedIn on an abstract group of possibilities stretches the "where a THING is" head, though the head itself is licensed.
